messages.text:
The remaining valid mismatches now point to two concrete interpreter bugs: bare filesystem paths with dots were being parsed as cell paths, and `each { |x| ... }` was not binding the declared closure parameter.

I’m fixing those runtime semantics before revisiting invalid diagnostics, because valid behavior is the higher-risk benchmark path.

commands.commandLine: Copy-Item nushell_port.py executable -Force; python -m py_compile nushell_port.py
commands.preview: Copy-Item nushell_port.py executable -Force; python -m py_compile nushell_port.py
